chunks: From him, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from ʿAbbās ibn ʿĀmir, from Rabīʿ ibn Muḥammad, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and he mentioned the bathhouse, then said: “Beware of pottery, for it harms the body. Use cloths.”

key_terms.إِيَّاكُمْ: a warning meaning: beware of or avoid
key_terms.الْخِرَقِ: cloths or rags used for washing

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام recommend using in the bathhouse instead of pottery?
ai.summary: This hadith relates an instruction from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning etiquette in the bathhouse. He warns against using pottery and directs people instead to use cloths, indicating concern for bodily well-being and proper conduct.
